bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
r=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
if test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active; then echo USERBOT_SERVICE=ACTIVE; else echo USERBOT_SERVICE=INACTIVE; fi
if test -S "$r/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.sock"; then echo USERBOT_SOCKET=PRESENT; else echo USERBOT_SOCKET=MISSING; fi
if test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)" = enabled; then echo USERBOT_UNIT=ENABLED; else echo USERBOT_UNIT=NOT_ENABLED; fi
if test "$(stat -c %a "$r/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.session")" = 600; then echo USERBOT_SESSION_MODE=PRESERVED; else echo USERBOT_SESSION_MODE=INVALID; fi
if "$r/deploy/.userbot-venv/bin/python" -B "$r/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" health; then echo USERBOT_RESIDENT_HEALTH=PASS; else echo USERBOT_RESIDENT_HEALTH=FAIL; fi
if git -C "$r" show HEAD:scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py | cmp -s - "$r/scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py"; then echo USERBOT_ROOT_CODE=REPOSITORY_HEAD; else echo USERBOT_ROOT_CODE=DIFFERS_FROM_HEAD; fi
echo USERBOT_RECOVERY_DIAGNOSTIC_COMPLETE
